summary: RRClub Mobile 2.0 pass. BLOCKER found+fixed: PartnerDashboard called useHashScroll after an early return (rules-of-hooks ESLint ERROR -> webpack 'Compiled with problems' overlay blocking all clicks in preview; would also fail CI builds). Moved hook above early return; recompiled clean. After fix: partner/influencer/admin bottom-nav tabs correct, hash navigation works, scanner modal + upload opens, QR PNG download works with no JS errors, desktop hides bottom-nav and shows the sidebar, PWA manifest/meta OK, the 12 backend P5 tests pass. Remaining issues are minor UX ones: hash targets land under the sticky header, tapping the same hash tab again does nothing, and two tabs show as active at once.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: useHashScroll(!!data) was called after `if (!data && loadError) return` -> react-hooks/rules-of-hooks compile error, dev overlay iframe intercepted all pointer events

scrollIntoView({block:'start'}) puts the target at top=0, under the 56px sticky mobile header, so the #validar card title and the 'Campanhas' heading are hidden. Add scroll-margin-top (e.g. scroll-mt-20) to #validar and #campanhas, or offset the scroll.

Tapping 'Ler QR' (or 'Cupões') again while the hash is already #validar does not scroll, because the effect depends only on hash. After the user scrolls up, the shortcut does nothing. Use location.key as a dependency or an onClick handler that scrolls.
NavLink ignores the hash, so on /parceiro#validar both Painel and Ler QR are active (and Painel and Cupões for influencer). Base the active state on location.hash.

issues: Influencer avatar image broken (alt text 'Influ' rendered)

action_items: Add a scroll offset for the sticky header on hash targets (#validar, #campanhas)
Make a repeated tap on a hash bottom-nav tab re-scroll
Fix the dual-active state for hash tabs in BottomNav
Fix the broken influencer avatar in partner Top Influencers
critical_code_review_comments: Hooks must never be placed after conditional returns. Check other pages that use useHashScroll (InfluencerDashboard is OK).
The torch button appears only when getRunningTrackCapabilities reports torch; not verifiable in headless.
